schemes.scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.short_description: Central scholarship support for eligible college and university students.
schemes.description: A Ministry of Education scholarship implemented through the National Scholarship Portal. The current detailed guideline thresholds and document checklist require a fresh authoritative guideline snapshot before production use.

benefits.description: Financial scholarship assistance for eligible college and university students; the current amount and course-stage schedule require verification.

schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

conditions.description: Applicant is above the 80th percentile among successful Class 12 candidates in the relevant stream and board.
conditions.notes: The benchmark models the board percentile as a numeric profile field.

conditions.description: Applicant satisfies the current annual family income threshold.
conditions.notes: No current numeric threshold was exposed in the retrievable Ministry page content.

conditions.description: Applicant is enrolled in a currently eligible regular course.
conditions.notes: Current course-mode wording requires a guideline snapshot.

conditions.description: Applicant satisfies the current rule regarding other scholarships or fee reimbursement.
conditions.notes: Current exclusion wording requires a guideline snapshot.

application_process.description: Open the National Scholarship Portal and complete the CSSS application when the current application cycle is available.

application_windows.application_cycle: Current cycle not announced as of 2026-08-07

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students
schemes.short_description: Maharashtra post-matric scholarship support for eligible OBC students.
schemes.description: A Maharashtra scheme administered through MahaDBT for eligible OBC students pursuing post-matric education, subject to domicile, income, attendance, course, gap, admission, and family-beneficiary conditions.

benefits.description: Tuition fee, examination fee, and maintenance allowance support according to the applicable course group and official schedule.

schemes.department: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra

root.description: Mandatory Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students conditions.

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Maharashtra.
Applicant belongs to the OBC social category.
Annual family income is at or below INR 250000.
Applicant has at least 75 percent attendance in the current year.
Applicant is pursuing post-matric education.
Education gap does not exceed two years.
Professional-course applicants must be admitted through CAP.
Course is not professional.
Professional-course admission was obtained through CAP.
The male-beneficiary limit does not disqualify the applicant.
Applicant is female and the male-child limit does not apply.
No more than two male beneficiaries in the family receive the benefit.

required_documents.name: Gap declaration when an education gap exists
Parent or guardian declaration regarding beneficiary children

application_process.description: Register or sign in on the MahaDBT applicant portal.
Complete the applicant profile, select Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students, upload the current required documents, and submit.

application_windows.application_cycle: Current cycle not verified as of 2026-08-07

verification.notes: The official indexed scheme content supports the pilot rules and checklist, but the dynamic MahaDBT pages require a manual browser snapshot before final release.

schemes.short_description: A MY Bharat internship initiative connecting eligible youth with structured industry experience.
schemes.description: The latest official MY Bharat implementation provides eligible youth with a structured internship experience. This record intentionally uses the 2026 MY Bharat implementation rather than older MCA-era benefit values and portal assumptions.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance during the internship period.
Structured industry exposure and practical work experience for the published internship duration.

schemes.department: Ministry of Corporate Affairs through MY Bharat

root.description: Current verified MY Bharat PM Internship eligibility conditions.

conditions.description: Applicant is at least 18 years old.
Applicant is no more than 25 years old.
Applicant has a currently listed eligible qualification.
conditions.notes: Undergraduate represents a completed or bachelor-level qualification in this Phase 0 profile model.

conditions.description: Applicant is not engaged in full-time education.
Applicant is not in full-time employment.
Applicant is an Indian citizen.
Applicant satisfies all current detailed exclusion conditions.
conditions.notes: The current detailed exclusion list was not fully available in the verified source content.

required_documents.name: Current MY Bharat PM Internship document checklist

application_process.description: Register or sign in on MY Bharat and complete the participant profile.
Open the PM Internship Scheme section and apply to available internship opportunities during an announced cycle.

application_windows.application_cycle: Next MY Bharat application cycle not announced as of 2026-08-07

verification.notes: All unresolved fields remain explicit and force NeedsInformation when no verified rule has failed.

schemes.short_description: Income support scheme providing Rs 6,000 per year to eligible farmer families across India.
schemes.description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme that provides financial support of Rs 6,000 per annum to landholding farmer families across India, transferred directly into their bank accounts in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 every four months.

benefits.description: Direct bank transfer of Rs 6,000 annually in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000.

conditions.description: Applicant family holds cultivable agricultural land.
Applicant or family member did not pay income tax in the last assessment year.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account

application_process.description: Register online at PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest Common Service Center (CSC).

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.short_description: Health coverage of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
schemes.description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health insurance scheme fully financed by the government. It provides a cover of Rs 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled public and private hospitals in India.

benefits.description: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to Rs 5,000,000 per family annually.

schemes.department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

conditions.description: Family is identified in SECC 2011 database or holds eligible ration card.

application_process.description: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit any empanelled hospital with Ayushman Mitra.

schemes.short_description: Financial assistance of Rs 1,500 per month for eligible women in Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years.
schemes.description: A flagship Maharashtra state government initiative aimed at financial independence, health, and nutrition for women. Eligible women receive direct monthly financial transfers of Rs 1,500.

benefits.description: Monthly direct financial support of Rs 1,500 transferred to Aadhaar-linked bank account.

schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Maharashtra.
Applicant is female.
Age is at least 21 years.
Age is no more than 65 years.
Annual family income does not exceed Rs 2.5 Lakhs.

required_documents.name: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate or 15-year old Ration Card
Income Certificate (Family income <= 2.5 Lakhs) or Yellow/Orange Ration Card

application_process.description: Apply online through Nari Shakti Doot App or official MahaDBT portal.

schemes.scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.short_description: Collateral-free working capital loan of up to Rs 50,000 for street vendors.
schemes.description: PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme providing street vendors with collateral-free working capital loans starting from Rs 10,000, with enhanced limits up to Rs 50,000 upon timely repayment, along with digital cashback incentives.

benefits.description: Collateral-free working capital loan up to Rs 50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.

schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

conditions.description: Applicant is an active street vendor in urban or peri-urban areas.

required_documents.name: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body

application_process.description: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through nearest CSC or lending bank branch.

schemes.short_description: High-interest tax-exempt savings scheme for the education and marriage of girl children.
schemes.description: Part of the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana offers attractive government-guaranteed interest rates and tax benefits under Section 80C for accounts opened for girl children up to 10 years of age.

benefits.description: High government interest rate (approx 8.2% p.a.) compounded annually with tax exemption.

schemes.department: Ministry of Finance & Department of Posts

conditions.description: Account opened for a girl child.
Girl child age is below 10 years at account opening.

application_process.description: Visit any India Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch to open SSY account.

schemes.short_description: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 Lakhs for micro and small non-corporate enterprises.
schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides micro-loans up to Rs 10 Lakhs under Shishu (up to 50k), Kishore (50k-5L), and Tarun (5L-10L) categories to non-farm micro/small enterprises and entrepreneurs.

benefits.description: Collateral-free business loan up to Rs 10,000,000 for entrepreneurship.

schemes.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

conditions.description: Applicant is at least 18 years old.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card

application_process.description: Apply online at udyamimitra.in or submit loan application to any commercial bank, MFI, or RRB branch.

schemes.short_description: Guaranteed pension scheme of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month for unorganized sector workers.
schemes.description: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) provides a guaranteed minimum monthly pension ranging from Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month after reaching 60 years of age, depending on contributions.

benefits.description: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after 60 years of age.

conditions.description: Age is at least 18 years at entry.
Age is no more than 40 years at entry.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card linked to Savings Account

application_process.description: Subscribe through net banking or visit your bank post office branch.

schemes.short_description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities.
schemes.description: PMFBY provides financial support and insurance coverage to farmers in the event of failure of any notified crop as a result of natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

benefits.description: Full crop loss financial compensation directly deposited into farmer bank accounts.

conditions.description: Applicant is a farmer growing notified crops.

required_documents.name: Land ownership paper or tenancy agreement

application_process.description: Enroll through PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in), bank branch, or insurance intermediary before cutoff date.

schemes.short_description: Financial subsidy for affordable housing construction and home loans for homeless and EWS/LIG families.
schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana provides pucca houses with basic amenities to all eligible urban and rural homeless and EWS/LIG families across India.

benefits.description: Direct financial assistance of up to Rs 2.67 Lakhs as interest subsidy or construction grant.

schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

conditions.description: Applicant family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members

application_process.description: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or visit local municipal office/CSC center.

schemes.short_description: Free industry-relevant skill training and certification for youth seeking jobs and self-employment.
schemes.description: PMKVY 4.0 is the flagship skill training scheme enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that helps them in securing a better livelihood.

benefits.description: Free skill training, government certification, assessment fees, and placement assistance.

schemes.department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

conditions.description: Age is between 15 and 45 years.

application_process.description: Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in) and choose desired training course.

schemes.short_description: Financial assistance of Rs 25,000 for girl children in Uttar Pradesh across 6 key developmental milestones.
schemes.description: A Uttar Pradesh state government initiative providing conditional cash transfers totaling Rs 25,000 to girl children from birth through higher education.

benefits.description: Rs 25,000 total financial assistance paid in instalments from birth to graduation.

schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
Annual family income does not exceed Rs 3 Lakhs.

application_process.description: Apply online on the official portal mksy.up.gov.in.

schemes.scheme_name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammal Scheme)
schemes.short_description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 1,000 for female students in Tamil Nadu pursuing higher education.
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu state scheme granting Rs 1,000 per month to female students who studied in government schools from Classes 6 to 12 and enrolled in degree or diploma courses.

benefits.description: Rs 1,000 monthly financial assistance directly deposited into student bank accounts.

schemes.department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Tamil Nadu.
Applicant is female.

application_process.description: Register on penkalvi.tn.gov.in through college nodal officer.

schemes.short_description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 2,000 for female heads of households in Karnataka.
schemes.description: Karnataka state scheme providing Rs 2,000 every month directly to female house heads (APL/BPL/Antyodaya ration card holders).

benefits.description: Rs 2,000 per month direct bank benefit to woman house head.

schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Karnataka

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Karnataka.
Applicant is female.

required_documents.name: BPL / APL Ration Card listing applicant as head of family

application_process.description: Apply online at sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in or visit Grama One / Karnataka One centers.

schemes.short_description: Scholarship assistance of Rs 2,500 to Rs 11,000 per year for children of farmers pursuing higher education.
schemes.description: Scholarship granted by Karnataka state government to students whose parents are farmers, encouraging higher education among agricultural families.

benefits.description: Annual scholarship of Rs 2,500 to Rs 11,000 depending on course stage.

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Karnataka.

required_documents.name: Farmer Identification (FID) or Land Record of Parent

application_process.description: Apply on State Scholarship Portal (SSP Karnataka) at ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in.

schemes.short_description: Annual scholarship of Rs 1,000 and one-time grant of Rs 25,000 for unmarried female students in West Bengal.
schemes.description: A globally recognized West Bengal conditional cash transfer scheme empowering adolescent girls and preventing child marriage.

benefits.description: Annual stipend K1 (Rs 1,000) and one-time K2 grant (Rs 25,000) at age 18.

schemes.department: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of West Bengal.
Applicant is female.

required_documents.name: Unmarried Certificate and School/College Enrollment Proof

application_process.description: Apply through school/educational institution portal at wbkanyashree.gov.in.

schemes.short_description: Higher education scholarship subsidy up to Rs 2 Lakhs per year for diploma, degree, and medical students in Gujarat.
schemes.description: Gujarat state scholarship providing up to 50% tuition fee assistance and hostel food allowance to meritorious students with family income <= Rs 6 Lakhs.

benefits.description: 50% tuition fee subsidy (up to Rs 2,000,000/yr for medical/engineering) + hostel allowance.

conditions.description: Applicant is a resident of Gujarat.
Annual family income is no more than Rs 6 Lakhs.

required_documents.name: Gujarat Income Certificate & Class 10/12 Marksheet (>= 80 percentile)

application_process.description: Apply online at mysy.guj.nic.in.
